name: local-synthetic-python-v1
description: 20 synthetic independent function implementation exercises. Handwritten deterministic checks; small capability smoke corpus, not research benchmark evidence. Public specifications and oracles are locally authored.

tasks.public_prompt: Implement `stable_unique` in solution.py using Python standard library only. Return unique hashable values preserving first occurrence. Function signature: stable_unique(x). Return the result, do not print. Add reasonable local checks if useful.
verifier_argv:
from solution import stable_unique
assert stable_unique([3, 1, 3, 2, 1]) == [3, 1, 2]
assert stable_unique([]) == []

Implement `rotate_left` in solution.py using Python standard library only. Rotate a list left by integer k; handle empty input and negative k. Function signature: rotate_left(x, n). Return the result, do not print. Add reasonable local checks if useful.
